# Development and validation dependencies for Mission Feeding Operations.
#
# A fresh clone without these produced errors that READ like schema failures
# (a missing yaml module surfacing mid-validator), which is exactly the wrong
# way to discover a missing dependency. tests/run_tests.sh checks these up
# front and says what to install instead.
#
# Fresh-clone sequence:
#     python3 -m venv .venv
#     source .venv/bin/activate
#     pip install -r requirements-dev.txt
#     bash tests/run_tests.sh
#
# The runtime product has NO Python dependency at all -- these exist only to
# validate the repository. Version floors are the ones the suite was proven
# on; anything newer within the same major is expected to work.
pyyaml>=6.0
jsonschema>=4.18       # needs the `referencing` resolver API
referencing>=0.30
